title: File:Lexington NC barbecue sign.jpg
author: Dennis Brown
description: Images from uptown Lexington North Carolina, including official buildings and landmarks. Sign commemorating the first place Lexington style barbecue was sold, and the State House recognizing Lexington as the Hickory-cooked Barbecue Capital of the Piedmont area of North Carolina.  Sign is on the side of the mayor's office near Center and State.
